name: es-irpf-deductions-murcia
description: Calculate Murcia regional credits for ordinary Spanish resident IRPF in 2026, for a taxpayer whose community of residence under LIRPF art. 72 is Murcia. Covers separate income tests for housing, families and care; housing conditions and preserved entitlement; water, renewable energy and electric transport; gifts and qualifying equity. Each row gives the credit's amount, cap, income gate, sharing rule and article, with incompatibilities and any carry-forward the law allows. Use for deducciones autonómicas Murcia, regional IRPF credits, alquiler, nacimiento, family, housing and gift relief in Murcia. Load es-irpf-deductions first for the residence test, the deduction ledger, the state and regional order of credits, the attributable-tax worksheet, national credits, deadlines and penalties, and es-income-tax for the bases and scales. Split unchanged from es-irpf-deductions on 6 November 2026.
